doc.name: Alexey Sound
doc.description: Production sound mixer / location sound recordist in Dubai, UAE (on set since 2012). Commercials, corporate films, documentaries, branded content, interviews, TV and video podcasts. Own professional kit, up to 10 mics at once. From AED 2,500 per day. Booking requests are passed to Alexey, never auto-confirmed.

skills.name: Service info
skills.description: Services, price, kit, FAQ, credits, reviews and contacts of a location sound recordist in Dubai / UAE.
examples: Find a sound recordist for a commercial shoot in Dubai
How much does a location sound mixer cost per day in the UAE?

skills.name: Booking request
skills.description: Send a shoot request (name, contact, dates, location, shoot type) to Alexey. He replies personally; nothing is confirmed automatically.
examples: Book a sound recordist for 2 days in Abu Dhabi next week
